transformation: Lossless JSON whitespace compaction and gzip. All samples, coordinates, masks and timestamps unchanged. API result includes retained Asset identity.
limitations: Synthetic covariate template and assumed reference; no participant data. Packaged recurrent CVAE and explicitly supplied reference; 300-second updates. City PMx plus assumed background is a PM2.5 input proxy; bounded nearby cells estimate masked inputs. Supplied humidity/activity is a counterfactual template, not synchronized city observations. Score and thermal proxy are heuristic; latent spread is not calibrated total uncertainty. Pollution and temperature use the declared smooth periodic Health replay. This is an extended scenario, not additional measured city data or a forecast; model state and sunlight clocks do not loop with those fields.
